title: Launch result
description: How a --launch battle ended: what the battle wrote into the pilot record, or why it did not run.

exit_code.description: The engine's exit code: 0 flown, 3 refused, 4 not reached, 5 failed.

goals_met_seconds.description: Seconds into the mission when the pilot's team met its goals; 0 when it never did.

score.description: The pilot's score; below zero when the pilot leaves a melee early.

why.description: A plain sentence when the battle was not flown; empty otherwise.

sith.description: The battle's Sith setting and how the Sith flight fared; destroyed is lost, a craft that jumped away or flew on lived.

flight_group.description: The promoted flight group's index; -1 when none was promoted.

flight_name.description: The promoted group's name from the mission; empty when none.

craft_type.description: The promoted group's craft type number; -1 when none.

why.description: Empty when a group was promoted or the setting is none; else why none was.
